A good nugget from this roundtable:

Almost 75% of Florida residents who attend state universities do not take out any student loans.

Of the students who do take out loans the average loan is a little more than 6 grand.

posts.text:
Why would Blanche say that the AG is “independent” as the media demands when it is not the way the Constitution is designed?  A cabinet officer is not independent of the President’s Article II executive power but is accountable to it.  

The Founders could have designed a fourth branch of government but they wisely declined to do so.
